scripts.build: mkdir -p public && (cd artifacts/pdf-tools && npx vite build --config vite.config.ts) && (cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/dist/public/. public/ || cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/dist/. public/ || cp -r artifacts/pdf-tools/public/. public/ || true); ls -la public/
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
